method: Actually viewed v1/v2 raws, 1x backgrounds, 8x NN and v2 inset 8x; identity master and four core references viewed before generation.
improvements: Face dominates frame with substantially shortened neck and only a narrow slate-blue work collar.
Center part, swept-back low braid, broad cheeks and short nose preserve identity and mature thirties reading.
Eye brightness reduced in 1x technical candidate, expression more firm than v1.
remaining_limitations: Eye whites remain brighter and larger than the intended small dark sclera, especially the visible near eye.
Hair still uses more parallel streaks than the ideal few connected masses.
Fine skin shading remnants remain, despite larger cheek/nose planes.
Inner brows and mouth retain some melancholy; controlled old anger/self-control is only partially achieved.
Raw alpha>=1 contains faint edge traces; alpha>=5 silhouette has real margins and no meaningful hair/ear clipping.
source_silhouette: Complete visible ear, crown and braid verified in v2 raw at alpha>=5/128. See portrait_v2_raw_margins.json. Technical inset is not restoration or a fix for clipped pixels.
technical_inset: Whole raw canvas isotropically contained into 72x98 then centered on 74x100 using NEAREST; no crop, nonuniform scaling or face painting.
